description: Urban Mobility Data for Causal Inference (Synthetic Spatiotemporal Dataset) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Christian Mulomba (Kyungsung University). This data is a synthetic spatiotemporal traffic dataset designed to serve as a benchmark for causal inference methods under observed confounding. It simulates traffic dynamics over a 10x10 spatial grid across 90 days at 15-minute intervals (all adjustable), yielding 864,000 observations. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
